verdict.rationale: Chroma Cloud is documented as a managed, serverless offering, and paying users corroborate it as zero-ops. Programmatic provisioning is only implied: the CLI can 'interact with your Chroma Cloud DBs' and the README says you can 'Create a DB', but neither explicitly documents creating or provisioning cloud databases through an API or CLI. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an API/CLI command for provisioning Cloud databases, independent hands-on confirmation of programmatic provisioning.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use a fully managed cloud version of the database with programmatic provisioning

citations.quote: Run it locally, self-host, or use Chroma Cloud for a managed, serverless experience.
The Chroma CLI lets you run a Chroma server locally on your machine, install sample apps, browse your collections, interact with your Chroma Cloud DBs, and much more!
Create a DB and try it out in under 30 seconds with $5 of free credits.
Happy paying user of Chroma Cloud here.
